question: Does recovery of monetary-activity observations change the incremental information about municipal consumption profiles and the prior research decision?
scope: Case1 retrospective descriptive attribution; no forecast, causal claim, new clusters or SME historical join
primary_target: Mean squared OOF error over five CLR coordinates of annual mean monthly normalized category profiles; equal municipality weight
secondary_target: Log annual mean monthly published total spending
population: Identical frozen core_eligible/conservative_eligible municipality-years from round3; recovery expands observed features, not eligible municipalities
new_features: Same log(published thousand_rubles*1000 / beginning-of-year population_total); positive finite source and population only; same three indicators
model: Ridge alpha=1; train-only medians and population-SD scaling; train-only categorical vocabulary; same core, eight industry shares and missing flags
folds: Reuse exact prior round3 core/stable municipality-key folds; complete samples restrict core folds without reassigning retained municipalities
complete_sample_caveat: Common and expanded complete samples fit on different row sets; their metric differences are descriptive and not a causal estimate of composition
paired_flags_recovery_interpretation: Both old/new missingness flags shared, folds and rows identical; values restored in new variant; median/scale refitted in training folds. Not causal or a pure coefficient effect
comparisons: Report numeric values beyond new flags; missingness vs rich baseline; legacy vs recovered pipeline; shared-two-vintage-flags value recovery
old_prediction_check: Recomputed legacy_full must match round3 economic_sectors_newvalues for core/stable exact folds within atol1e-9, rtol1e-9
invariance_check: On common_complete_new3, old/new features and predictions coincide within atol1e-9, rtol1e-9
uncertainty: 2000 paired region bootstrap resamples of fixed OOF row losses, seed13, percentile95%; intervals conditional on trained predictions, no pipeline refit or multiple-testing adjustment
negative_controls: Core seed13 bothyears/regimes: independently permute each observed monetary column within region, separately within train and test. Three fixed seeds 91013,91029,91047; missing positions remain fixed; descriptive diagnostics not permutation p-values
ablations: Core seed13: omit each investment/shipments/retail value in turn; retain missing flags; no retuning
adoption: Unchanged: primary gain >=1% in both years and both regimes, positive lower95% CI, and no reversal on stable-code sample; otherwise retain descriptive-context status
availability: Current 2026 snapshots of contemporaneous annual values; first publication/revision times unknown; no historical real-time availability claim
evaluation_contacts: Both years and municipal examples have been inspected in previous rounds; this entire follow-up is exploratory
prohibited_inferences: resident income from activity per person
legal boundary identity from same publisher geometry
unique SME firms from period-row count
sum of workers across repeated records or missing IP workers
new monetary values automatically improve economic clusters
